title: Using grading without wasting cards
target: How to use card grading in TCG Card Shop Simulator deliberately, instead of sending cards off and losing track of what it cost you.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Money for the service and the delivery fee
A shop that can trade without those cards

steps.do: Read the whole cost on the submit screen rather than only the price per card.
steps.because: the screen shows the per-card cost, the delivery fee and the total separately (m_ServiceDeliveryFeeText)

steps.do: Choose the service by its days as well as its price.
steps.because: each grading service carries its own days and its own cost per card (GradeCardServiceData)

steps.do: Only send cards you can do without while they are away.
steps.because: a submission holds your cards until it comes back (GradeCardSubmitSet)

steps.do: Check the status screen instead of wondering whether it has finished.
steps.because: there is a status screen with days left and a progress bar (GradingProgressSetPanelUI)

steps.do: Open the returns deliberately, because the reveal is its own sequence.
steps.because: graded cards come back through an opening sequence (GradedCardOpeningSequence)

commonMistakes: Reading only the per-card price and forgetting the delivery fee.
Grading cards you needed on the shelf that week.
Sending a set off and then never looking at its status.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
